intent: Review the current website case-study release before production merge.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: The release adds evidence cards to the established Esteban portfolio without changing its shared visual system or introducing a new brand direction.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: No usar emojis salvo petición explícita de Gonzalo.
visual_evidence.comparison: The established Esteban case-study card and reading path compared with the new current Gains From Geebs website evidence card.

brief.visitor: A prospective client checking whether Esteban has documented real, current web work before starting a conversation.
brief.promise: Each case identifies a live website and visible interface facts without presenting unmeasured business results as proof.
brief.primary_action: Open the case detail and continue to Esteban's relevant service or contact page.
brief.friction: The portfolio previously omitted four current web builds despite having public interfaces that can be verified directly.

kpi.event: service or contact action from a case study
kpi.baseline: UNKNOWN: no comparable case-study attribution read this session
kpi.evidence: Current public interfaces were captured before the release.
kpi.decision_rule: retain factual cases unless later measured inquiry data shows a quality regression.

concept.idea: Add four compact website proof cards using actual public interface captures.
concept.brand_reason: The portfolio stays editorial and lets the verified work carry the evidence.
concept.interaction: Existing cards and case-study navigation remain the interaction model.
concept.visible_response: A visitor can see the current interface and open bilingual detail routes without animation-gated facts.
concept.alternatives: No invented outcome claims, generic SEO pages, autoplay, or new brand treatment.

story.opening: The portfolio shows the project name and its real current interface.
story.action: The visitor opens a short bilingual case and can continue to the relevant service.
story.consequence: The portfolio gives concrete evidence of current web delivery without claiming unverified results.

content.visible: Project title, current interface image, source-bounded website summary and existing next step.
content.linked_depth: Existing portfolio, service and contact routes.

references.borrow: Existing Esteban portfolio card, case-study template and bilingual route behavior.
references.avoid: Generic portfolio styling, external embeds and performance claims without source data.

components.reuse: case-studies data model, portfolio cards, localization and sitemap machinery.
components.local_reason: This is a bounded evidence update inside existing Esteban components.

verification.rendered_states: Desktop candidate capture plus phone and desktop local route review.
verification.motion: No motion gates words or the current website screenshots.
verification.accessibility_performance: Existing semantic card and link behavior remains; screenshots are optimized static assets.
verification.raw_html: Initial HTML includes project facts and route content.
verification.conversion_boundary: Existing contact route remains available; no message is sent.

learning.baseline_source: UNKNOWN: no dated case-study attribution export is available
learning.baseline_value: UNKNOWN: no dated case-study attribution export is available
learning.target: case-study service or contact action to qualified inquiry
learning.hypothesis: Current, source-bounded website examples help a visitor evaluate whether their project resembles documented work.
learning.decision_rule: Keep factual proof after release verification; do not assert business effect until attributable data exists.
learning.registration_condition: Record comparable production event availability before outcome grading.
